brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief - Key developments in Climate Finance, Indo-Pacific Security, Disaster Management, Tribal Welfare, and Deep Ocean Exploration.

articles.title: RBI Framework on Climate-Related Financial Risks Operationalised
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has mandated comprehensive disclosures on climate-related financial risks for regulated financial entities.
prelims: Aligned with recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD).
Applies to all Scheduled Commercial Banks (excluding RRBs) and Tier-4 NBFCs.
Introduces standardized metrics for green capital adequacy and climate scenario stress testing.
articles.mains: Discuss how integrating climate risk into monetary and regulatory policy frameworks safeguards macroeconomic stability in emerging economies.

articles.title: India-ASEAN Joint Maritime Security Protocol Finalised
articles.summary: India and ASEAN member nations finalized a standard operational protocol to enhance maritime domain awareness and counter-piracy operations in the Indo-Pacific.
prelims: Supports India's SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) and the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI).
Focuses on securing Sea Lines of Communication (SLOCs) across the Malacca Strait.
Facilitates real-time information exchange via the Information Fusion Centre – Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR).
articles.mains: Analyze the strategic significance of ASEAN-India maritime cooperation in upholding international law under UNCLOS and maintaining open trade routes.

articles.title: Deployment of Automated GLOF Early Warning Systems in the Himalayas
articles.summary: The National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) has completed the installation of sensor-based Glacial Lake Outburst Flood monitoring systems across vulnerable high-altitude lakes.
prelims: Monitors high-risk glacial lakes including South Lhonak and Shako Cho in the Eastern Himalayas.
Integrates Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite imagery with water-level automated telemetry.
Linked directly to the National Emergency Operation Centre (NEOC) for real-time alerting.
articles.mains: Examine the role of technology-driven early warning mechanisms in mitigating disaster vulnerabilities across fragile Himalayan mountain ecosystems.

articles.title: Progress Review of PM-PVTG Development Mission
articles.summary: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs released an impact assessment showing expanded infrastructure, health, and education access across 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
prelims: Targets 75 PVTG habitations spread across 18 States and 1 Union Territory.
Criteria for PVTG identification include declining/stagnant population, pre-agricultural technology, low literacy, and subsistence economy.
Nodal Ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, implemented via convergence of 9 central ministries.
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the targeted interventions required to balance tribal cultural preservation with modern socio-economic integration.

articles.title: Ocean Trials Conducted for Indigenous Deep-Sea Mining Crawler
articles.summary: India's Deep Ocean Mission achieved a milestone with successful deep-sea trials of a self-propelled mining crawler at depths exceeding 5,000 metres.
prelims: Developed by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
Designed to harvest Polymetallic Nodules containing Nickel, Cobalt, Copper, and Manganese.
Operations conducted in the Central Indian Ocean Basin (CIOB) site allocated by the International Seabed Authority (ISA).
articles.mains: Assess the strategic and economic importance of deep-sea mining for India's clean energy transition alongside the associated environmental concerns under UNCLOS.
